title: Bracket balance
statement: Start simple: Return true when every bracket in the text is closed by its matching type in the correct order. Other characters are ignored. The theory is optional. The C solution appears after the hidden tests pass.
think: The most recent open bracket must close first.
A stack stores unmatched open brackets.
A close bracket fails when the stack is empty or the types differ.
The text is balanced only when the stack is empty at the end.
hints: Compare each closing bracket with the most recent opening bracket.
Reject a closing bracket when nothing is open.
